<h2><a href=https://www.codewars.com/kata/6a3ce10b3ac2038a3741c9b8/train/python target="_blank">Tire Rotations</a></h2><h3>7 kyu</h3><p>A tire size is written in the format <code>"205/55R16"</code> where:</p><ul><li><code>205</code> → tire width in millimeters</li><li><code>55</code> → aspect ratio (sidewall height as a percentage of width)</li><li><code>16</code> → rim diameter in inches</li></ul><p>The construction code between aspect ratio and rim diameter can be <code>R</code>, <code>ZR</code>, <code>B</code>, or <code>D</code>.</p><p><img alt="tire" src="data:image/png;base64,"></p><p>Given a tire size string and a distance in kilometers, return the number of rotations the tire makes.</p><p><strong>Function signature:</strong></p><pre><code class="language-python"><span class="cm-keyword">def</span> <span class="cm-def">tire_rotations</span>(<span class="cm-variable">tire_size</span>: <span class="cm-builtin">str</span>, <span class="cm-variable">distance_km</span>: <span class="cm-builtin">float</span>) <span class="cm-operator">-</span><span class="cm-operator">&gt;</span> <span class="cm-builtin">float</span>:</code></pre><p><strong>Examples:</strong></p><pre><code class="language-python"><span class="cm-variable">tire_rotations</span>(<span class="cm-string">"205/55R16"</span>, <span class="cm-number">110</span>) <span class="cm-variable">≈</span> <span class="cm-number">55410.8047</span><span class="cm-variable">tire_rotations</span>(<span class="cm-string">"185/65ZR15"</span>, <span class="cm-number">900</span>) <span class="cm-variable">≈</span> <span class="cm-number">460947.5423</span><span class="cm-variable">tire_rotations</span>(<span class="cm-string">"225/45B17"</span>, <span class="cm-number">0</span>) <span class="cm-operator">==</span> <span class="cm-number">0.0</span></code></pre><p><strong>Notes:</strong></p><ul><li>Use <code>π = math.pi</code></li><li>1 inch = 25.4 mm</li></ul>
